content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the document.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Searches for "most favoured/favored", "no less favorable/favourable" and a full read of the Agreement (single Preamble section, paras p0000–p0074, including the Fees and Payment clause at p0023) return no most-favoured-nation or price/terms-matching provision in either direction. There is therefore no MFN obligation on AP as Customer, which is the playbook's preferred position; the non-exclusivity language in Section 1 reinforces that AP remains free to deal with other agents and third parties on any terms. No redline required. Note only that the Agreement also grants AP no MFN in its favour, which is welcome-but-absent and not a deviation.
